EXPEDITION 01 · Environmental Awareness

WAR FOR SURVIVAL

An experiential challenge centred on environmental awareness, resource management and survival preparedness. Through strategic problem-solving and scenario-based activities, participants explore the significance of adaptability, resource optimisation and informed decision-making in addressing environmental uncertainties and real-world challenges.

Schedule & registration · To be announced

STRUCTURAENGINEER A RESILIENT FUTURE

EXPEDITION 02 · Engineering & Design

STRUCTURA

An engineering and design challenge focused on sustainable architecture and disaster-resilient infrastructure. From earthquake-resistant structures to flood-resilient designs, the event encourages participants to apply engineering principles and innovative design approaches towards developing infrastructure that safeguards communities, addresses environmental vulnerabilities and supports sustainable development.

Schedule & registration · To be announced

EXPEDITION 03 · Technology & Innovation

ECO-HACK

A 12-hour intensive technology-driven innovation challenge that provides participants with a platform to conceptualise, develop and present solutions to pressing environmental and societal challenges.

  • Rapid prototyping
  • Interdisciplinary collaboration
  • Technical proficiency
  • Application of emerging technologies
  • Solutions aligned with Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)

Schedule & registration · To be announced

EXPEDITION 04 · Sustainability & Ideation

GREEN IDEATHON

A sustainability-focused ideation platform that brings together young minds across Junior and Senior categories to identify challenges and envision innovative solutions for a greener future.

  • Conceptualise and refine innovative ideas
  • Present practical and impactful solutions
  • Address environmental conservation
  • Promote sustainable resource utilisation
  • Tackle pressing societal concerns
  • Foster creativity, critical thinking and innovation

Schedule & registration · To be announced
